page.layout: One printed page, single column of contents. Title block centred at top (ELENCHUS CAPITUM DISSERTATIONIS SECUNDAE), then chapter entries CAP. I to CAP. V, each with an italic summary and a page number at the right. Signature line at the foot with "** 3" and "CAP." at right. A watermark-like "Digitized by Google" banner at lower right is omitted.

main_text.head: ELENCHUS CAPITUM DISSERTATIONIS SECUNDAE
CAP. I.
main_text.p: Sequentis Dissertationis argumentum. Rationes rejectae ab Aliis sententia Lightfooti examinantur. Rector Academiae ex Synagoga non excludendus. Multo minus Collectores Eleemosynarum. De Diaconis N. T. & hodierno illius vocis usu. 135
main_text.head: CAP. II.
main_text.p: Continuatur idem argumentum de Diaconis Ecclesiae Christianae. Paulus quoque in Epistolis suis de iisdem agere probatur, & rationibus partim ex SS. partim ex historia Ecclesiastica desumtis. 163
main_text.head: CAP. III.
main_text.p: Rationes, ob quas Samuelis Petiti sententia de variis Synagogae praefectis rejicitur, excutiuntur. Hujus institutum defenditur. 181
main_text.head: CAP. IV.
main_text.p: Sam. Petiti sententia ulterius defenditur, atque etiam emendatur. Tituli Praefectorum Synagogae, qui in legibus Imperatorum occurrunt, explicantur. 192
main_text.head: CAP. V.
main_text.p: Ratio, quam Vir Doctus affert, numeri denarii ad Synagogam constituendam requisiti, refutatur: genuina ratio ex mente Hebraeorum proponitur. 207

page.notes: Blue ink marks and underlines in the scan are not printed text and are not transcribed. The initial S of the first summary is a large decorative letter, read as part of the first word. Some words in the italic summaries are faint; the reading follows the most likely form.
